name: obsidian-update
description:
v2.8.0: the standup team-completions harvest reads the Jira board (project MOXY) instead of the Slack Canvas, per the org move to Jira as the tracker; last_standup_read lives in the team-kanban config note. Vault-native personal operating system with Council integration. Combines energy-aware daily ops, three-layer persistent memory, Kanban task management, session knowledge extraction, Jira (MOXY) team completions harvest, and bidirectional Council deliberation verification — all persisted to the MoxyWolf Obsidian vault on Google Drive. v2.7.0 adds Decision Record auto-routing: every DR write is classified by topic (engineering / GTM / brand / compliance / operating-norm / product / agents-and-plugins / personnel) and filed to the canonical folder, every DR is appended to the new Company Decision Log master index at _Shared Knowledge/Operating Norms/_INDEX.md, and project-scoped DRs also append to the project hub's

Decisions.md — see references/dr-auto-routing.md.
